lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Assessment preparation: proportional and algebraic models

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A data set has the values 25, 30, 35, 40, 45. The mean is 35. What is the mean absolute deviation (MAD), a measure of the data's uncertainty or spread?
A student claims a box that is 5 by 3 by 7 units has a volume of 115 cubic units. Evaluate the claim.
choices: No; the volume is 116 cubic units, not 115.
Cannot be determined from the given information.
No; the volume is 117 cubic units, not 115.
No; the volume is 105 cubic units, not 115.

items.prompt: A rental company charges a $5 base fee plus $2 per hour. A customer's total bill was $29. Which equation models this situation, and how many hours were rented?

A diver starts at the surface (0 m) and descends 21 m, then descends another 13 m, then ascends 7 m. The dive plan assumes a depth limit of 40 m below the surface. What is the diver's final position, as a signed number of meters?
A model predicts a $860 rate will decrease by 10%. What does the model predict as the new rate?
A storage container is designed as a rectangular prism 10 ft long, 5 ft wide, and 2 ft high. What is its volume in cubic feet?
A data set has the values 9, 24, 39, 54, 69. The mean is 39. What is the mean absolute deviation (MAD), a measure of the data's uncertainty or spread?
A student claims a box that is 4 by 5 by 2 units has a volume of 49 cubic units. Evaluate the claim.
choices: Cannot be determined from the given information.
Yes; the volume is 49 cubic units.
No; the volume is 40 cubic units, not 49.
No; the volume is 51 cubic units, not 49.
